build_GaussianMixtureModel: build a GaussianMixtureModel with k components using Dirichlet, Normal, and Gamma distributions
test_GaussianMixtureModel_inference: test the GaussianMixtureModel by running CompositionalInference with SingleSiteNewtonianMonteCarlo on queries and observations
generate_BMGInference_dot_graph: generate a DOT graph representation of the GMM model using BMGInference to_dot method
generate_BMGInference_cpp_code: generate C++ graph code for the GMM model using BMGInference to_cpp method
run_GMM_compilation_test: run the end-to-end compilation test for a 1D GMM with 4 components and 6 observations
